pages.text: If you want to look more like a real catgirl, you definitely need $(#FF69B4)Neko Armor$()!$(br2)toNeko provides two unique armor pieces: $(item)Neko Ears$() and $(item)Neko Tail$(). They change your appearance when worn — the tail and ears will sway naturally, instantly maxing out your cuteness~

$(item)Neko Ears$() are equipped in the $(#FF69B4)helmet slot$().$(br2)Once worn, a pair of fluffy cat ears will appear on your head — they twitch and sway with your movements, just like real cat ears!$(br2)The crafting recipe is simple: just $(item)Wool$() will do~

$(item)Neko Tail$() is equipped in the $(#FF69B4)chestplate slot$().$(br2)A slender cat tail will sway behind you, swinging side to side as you walk.$(br2)$(#FF69B4)Note:$() when first equipping the tail, you'll feel a sharp sting — you'll lose $(#FF69B4)0.5 hearts$() of health. Growing a tail comes at a small price, meow~
Crafting the tail requires $(item)Iron Nuggets$() and $(item)Wool$().

pages.title: Dyeing
pages.text: Put $(item)Neko Ears$(), $(item)Neko Tail$() or $(item)Neko Paws$() in a $(thing)crafting grid$() together with any $(item)Dye$() to color them; just like leather armor, dyeing again mixes the colors.$(br2)To reset the color, wash the dyed piece in a water-filled $(item)Cauldron$().

pages.title: Trinkets Support
pages.text: If you have the $(thing)Trinkets$() mod installed, neko armor can be equipped in $(#FF69B4)trinket slots$() without occupying regular armor slots:$(br2)$(li)Neko Ears → Head trinket slot$(li)Neko Tail → Back trinket slot$(br2)This lets you wear full diamond armor AND neko armor at the same time — powerful AND cute!

pages.title: Curios Support
pages.text: With $(thing)Curios$() installed on NeoForge, the ears and tail get $(#FF69B4)dedicated curio slots$():$(br2)$(li)Neko Ears → $(thing)ears$() slot$(li)Neko Tail → $(thing)tail$() slot$(br2)By default they stay in their own slots instead of competing with helmets and backpacks for $(thing)head$() / $(thing)back$(), so you can wear a helmet and cat ears at the same time~$(br2)Ears and tails already equipped in the head/back curio slots in $(#FF69B4)old saves$() keep working (the original slots are still available).
